articles.title: US-Zollpolitik: Gericht lässt Trumps globale Zehn-Prozent-Zölle vorerst bestehen
articles.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat das Urteil eines Handelsgerichts vorerst gestoppt, das seine Importzölle für ungültig erklärt hatte. Nun prüfen Berufungsrichter die Sache.
articles.image_title: US-Zollpolitik: Shipping containers are piled at the Port of Los Angeles, California, on May 9, 2026. A US trade court on May 7, dealt US President Donald Trump a fresh setback, ruling against the 10-percent global tariffs he instituted after the Supreme Court struck down many earlier duties. The 2-1 ruling by the US Court of International Trade, for now, blocks the tariffs from being implemented against just two companies and the state of Washington, but it could open doors to further such outcomes. (Photo by Frederic J. BROWN / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Steuerskandal: Cum-Ex-Drahtzieher Hanno Berger muss zehn Jahre in Haft

articles.image_title: Steuerskandal: WIESBADEN, GERMANY - MAY 30: Defendant Hanno Berger arrives at a courtroom at the District Court for the announcement of the verdict in the trial over the 'Cum-Ex' scandal, a massive tax fraud scam that cost the government billions of euros, on May 30, 2023 in Wiesbaden, Germany. The court sentenced tax attorney Hanno Berger to a long prison term for his involvement and found the 72-year-old guilty of three counts of serious tax evasion and ordered eight years and three months in prison and the confiscation of one million euros. The Bonn Regional Court had already sentenced Berger to eight years in prison in December 2022. (Photo by Helmut Fricke - Pool/Getty Images)
